cohort: 68 women seeking Medical Termination of Pregnancy between 20-24 weeks of gestation.
finding: The study found that the majority of women undergoing MTP between 20-24 weeks were aged 18-30 with high parity, misoprostol alone was the most common method, 29.4% experienced complications (primarily retained products of conception), and only 47.1% adopted post-abortal contraception.
